caseName: Anderson Bros. v. Board of Supervisors of Washington County
caseNameFull: Anderson Brothers Corp. v. Board of Supervisors of Washington County
attorneys: Victor W. Bouldin for appellant., John E. Stone for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of Mississippi.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a properly presented federal question.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Black would dismiss for want of a substantial federal question.
